monitor.capture_what: return value of sanitize_svg_content — the sanitized SVG string

oracle_check.condition_description: The returned sanitized SVG content still contains a script tag or script end tag variant (e.g., </script >) that should have been removed, indicating the regex filter was bypassed
oracle_check.raise_message_template: BAD_TAG_FILTER: Script tag survived SVG sanitization — captured={captured} pattern={matched_pattern}

fuzz_guidance.skip_condition: not svg_content or '<' not in svg_content
